sentences.show: A president ordered his top lawyer to fire a prosecutor. He resigned instead. So did his deputy.
It happened on this night in 1973.
Special prosecutor Archibald Cox was investigating Watergate.
He wanted the secret tapes Richard Nixon had recorded in the White House.
Nixon ordered Attorney General Elliot Richardson to fire him.
Nixon gave the same order to his deputy, William Ruckelshaus.
The third man in line, Robert Bork, carried out the order.
America called it the Saturday Night Massacre.
Ten days later, the impeachment process began.
Less than ten months later, Nixon himself resigned.
Also on this day: the Sydney Opera House opened after fourteen years of building, and Maria Theresa took the Habsburg throne.
